## Verification before merge
- [ ] I verified that every changed page and its business facts are accurate, or this PR has no customer-page changes.
- [ ] I checked existing experiments, routing/phone, qualification, image and form dependencies where relevant.
- [ ] I inspected all applicable CI results on the **latest PR SHA**, including whether each diagnostic actually ran and its inspected-page count.
- [ ] For customer-facing changes, rendered/mobile output, local URLs, forms and phone routes were tested or blockers are listed.
- [ ] High-risk SEO controls have explicit owner approval, URL-level impact list and rollback procedure, or N/A with reason.
- [ ] No fabricated pickups, reviews, storefronts, false free guarantees or unapproved service-area claims.

## Release and measurement (fill after merge)

- Public live URL verified and timestamp (**do not infer from a merge**):
- GSC indexed/canonical status, if actually inspected:

- Customer form receipt verified, or why unverified:
- Change register entry and unresolved follow-ups:

> A green job is not a verified business outcome. Report only the highest proven state. Read `SEO-CHANGE-CONTROL.md`.
